sentences.en: What did you discuss with the other governors, both Democratic and Republican, while you were there?

sentences.en: Well, you go to the White House.

sentences.en: I've been as governor with other presidents.

sentences.en: I've been as attorney general.

sentences.en: And you go with the expectation that you're going to hear the president articulate some vision for the future.
sentences.zh: 你去的时候是带着期望的，希望听到总统阐述对未来的某种愿景。

sentences.en: It's supposed to be an opportunity to talk about how governors and states can work with a new administration.
sentences.zh: 这本应是一个讨论州长和各州如何与新政府合作的机会。

sentences.en: That wasn't what this was about.
sentences.zh: 但这次会议并非如此。

sentences.en: The meeting began with an address by Stephen Miller for about 15, 20 minutes.
sentences.zh: 会议开始时，斯蒂芬·米勒发表了大约15到20分钟的讲话。

sentences.en: And then later, the president came out and began by recounting that he's got the highest approval rating of anybody this early in his tenure, that he won the election not once, not

sentences.en: So it was unfortunate because I'm there as governor thinking, let's have a conversation about maybe where we can work together, right?

sentences.en: How can we focus on the needs of everyday Americans?

sentences.en: But unfortunately, we didn't see any of that.
sentences.zh: 但不幸的是，我们什么也没看到。

sentences.en: What was also upsetting is that we saw him attack another governor.

sentences.en: This is something that—

sentences.en: And we should say this was about transgender rights and about his executive order to do with transgender rights.
sentences.zh: 我们应该说明，这是关于跨性别权利以及他关于跨性别权利的行政命令。

sentences.en: And then he called her out, right?
sentences.zh: 然后他点名了她，对吧？

sentences.zh: 然后她回应说，基本上，她会遵守本州和联邦政府的法律，并且会在法庭上见他。

sentences.en: And that didn't seem to go down well.

sentences.en: No.

sentences.zh: 他正在做他一贯做的事情，那就是：我要抛出一个议题。

sentences.en: Let that be the distraction.
sentences.zh: 让它成为干扰项。

sentences.en: What I saw as so upsetting in that exchange was when he looked at her and I was sitting at the table and he leered at her and he said, we are the federal law.

sentences.en: We are the federal law.

sentences.en: I may not agree with everything Congress does, but that's a democracy.

sentences.en: That's how our system works.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们制度运作的方式。

sentences.en: Congress makes the laws.
sentences.zh: 国会制定法律。

sentences.en: The judiciary enforces the laws and determines the application of the law.
sentences.zh: 司法部门执行法律并决定法律的适用。

sentences.en: And the executive, and I'm an executive, my job is to faithfully apply and execute the law, right?
sentences.zh: 而行政部门——我就是行政人员——我的工作是忠实地应用和执行法律，对吧？

sentences.en: And so that's a problem.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: He doesn't believe that Congress makes the law.
sentences.zh: 他不相信国会制定法律。

sentences.en: He believes that he makes the law.
sentences.zh: 他相信是他制定法律。

sentences.en: That's what he said.
sentences.zh: 他就是这么说的。

sentences.en: The other thing he said as you will see no federal funding, which, you know, again, is counter to the way our system operates, which is, you know, Congress appropriates funds.
sentences.zh: 他说的另一件事是你们将得不到任何联邦资金，这再次违背了我们制度的运作方式，即国会拨款。

sentences.en: Congress debates and figures out, you know, where funding is going to go.

sentences.zh: 他想要将资金武器化并扣留的想法太可怕了。

sentences.en: That also became quite clear.

sentences.en: Look at all the layoffs.
sentences.zh: 看看所有的裁员。

sentences.en: And remember, a third of the federal employee workforce are veterans.

sentences.en: So they are acting in ways that are diametrically opposed to what we're trying to do as governors,
sentences.zh: 所以他们的行为与我们作为州长试图做的事情截然相反，

sentences.en: That's outrageous.

sentences.zh: 这已经成为一种模式。

sentences.en: And I'm curious, do you think that AGs should be getting in these federal fights so consistently?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，您认为总检察长们应该如此持续地卷入这些联邦层面的斗争吗？

sentences.en: I think the premise of that question is totally off.
sentences.zh: 我认为那个问题的前提完全是错误的。

sentences.en: Tell me why.
sentences.zh: 说说看为什么。

sentences.en: And I think the notion that these are, quote, political fights is totally off.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为所谓这些是“政治斗争”的说法也完全站不住脚。

sentences.en: When I brought suits as an attorney general and when other AGs I worked with brought suits, because a lot of these were multi-state suits, why were they multi-state suits?
sentences.zh: 当我担任总检察长提起诉讼时，以及我共事的其他总检察长提起诉讼时——因为其中很多是跨州诉讼——为什么它们会是跨州诉讼呢？

sentences.en: Why were a bunch of AGs joining in the same lawsuit?
sentences.zh: 为什么那么多总检察长会加入同一场诉讼？

sentences.en: It's because there was some action taken by Trump during Trump 1 that hurt people in our states.
sentences.zh: 那是因为特朗普在第一个任期内采取了一些伤害我们州民众的行动。

sentences.en: As attorney general, you're there to represent the people of your state, to protect their interests, and to protect their rights.
sentences.zh: 作为总检察长，你的职责是代表本州人民，保护他们的利益，捍卫他们的权利。

sentences.en: So when somebody like Donald Trump illegally cuts off access to health care, violates the law, of course your AG can and should sue.
sentences.zh: 所以，当像唐纳德·特朗普这样的人非法切断医疗保健渠道、违反法律时，你的总检察长当然可以也应该起诉。

sentences.en: That's not a political issue.
sentences.zh: 那不是政治问题。

sentences.en: That's an attorney general doing his or her job vindicating the rights.
sentences.zh: 那是总检察长在履行职责，维护人们的权利。

sentences.en: Then you saw Republicans do the same, obviously, during the Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 然后你显然也看到了共和党人在拜登政府期间做了同样的事情。

sentences.en: And they would argue that they were doing the same thing.
sentences.zh: 他们会辩称自己也在做同样的事。

sentences.en: They can argue that.
sentences.zh: 他们可以那样辩解。

sentences.en: They can argue that.
sentences.zh: 他们确实可以那样辩解。

sentences.en: I will tell you, having worked with many Republican colleagues, I will tell you what those fights were about.
sentences.zh: 但我可以告诉你，在与许多共和党同事共事后，我可以告诉你那些斗争的本质是什么。

sentences.en: They were fights to gum up the works, to slow things down.
sentences.zh: 那些斗争是为了阻挠工作，为了拖慢进程。

sentences.en: They didn't like some of the policymaking that was going on.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢当时正在进行的一些政策制定。

sentences.en: They didn't like the fact that EPA was out there promoting and promulgating new regulations, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，他们不喜欢环保署在外面推动和颁布新法规的事实。

sentences.en: And so they'd try to find ways to slow that down.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会想方设法去拖慢这些进程。

sentences.en: I'm not saying, you know, in every instance it was frivolous, but there's a reason why Democratic AGs won over 85% of those cases during Trump won.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说每一项诉讼都是无理取闹，但民主党总检察长在特朗普第一任期内赢得了超过85%的案件，这是有原因的。

sentences.en: We were right.
sentences.zh: 我们是正确的。

sentences.en: And I think that's what you're going to see again now with Trump, too.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为现在特朗普再次上台，你也会看到同样的情况。

sentences.en: Now, the courts have changed some.
sentences.zh: 现在，法院已经发生了一些变化。

sentences.en: So how this ultimately plays out, we don't— I was about to say, are you confident that the courts can actually constrain this administration?
sentences.zh: 所以最终结果会如何，我们并不——我正想问，你是否有信心法院真的能约束这届政府？

sentences.en: Well, I have great hope in the courts.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我对法院寄予厚望。

sentences.en: You know, they're an important institution.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它们是一个重要的机构。

sentences.en: They're one of our pillars of government.
sentences.zh: 它们是我们政府的支柱之一。

sentences.en: So I want to remain ever optimistic about the role of and the responsibility of the judiciary.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望对司法机构的角色和责任始终保持乐观。

sentences.en: I can't predict how it's going to go.
sentences.zh: 我无法预测事情会如何发展。

sentences.en: But those lawsuits, where there's a violation of the law, those AGs need to continue to sue.
sentences.zh: 但对于那些违反法律的诉讼，总检察长们需要继续起诉。

sentences.en: And that's not political.
sentences.zh: 那不是政治行为。

sentences.en: It's about doing their job in vindicating people's rights in their states.
sentences.zh: 那是为了履行职责，维护本州人民的权利。

sentences.en: But it's not just up to the AGs.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅仅取决于总检察长们。

sentences.en: I think about senators like Chris Murphy and Brian Schatz, you know, out there just articulating, just in very real terms,
sentences.zh: 我想到像克里斯·墨菲和布莱恩·沙茨这样的参议员，你知道，他们只是在外面用非常实在的语言阐述，

sentences.en: what the harm of Trump's actions are to everyday Americans.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的行为对普通美国人造成的伤害是什么。

sentences.en: You see more and more Americans speaking up, too.
sentences.zh: 你也看到越来越多的美国人站出来发声了。

sentences.en: And that's really, really important because I think it's been overwhelming for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 这真的非常非常重要，因为我认为这对很多人来说已经不堪重负了。

sentences.en: I mean, it's only been a month, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，才过去一个月，对吧？

sentences.en: And people have been hit with a lot.
sentences.zh: 人们已经遭受了太多的冲击。

sentences.en: But I did seem to catch Democrats by surprise.
sentences.zh: 但这确实似乎让民主党人感到措手不及。

sentences.en: I mean, we have seen Democrats take a beat and have trouble coming to an agreement about what kind of resistance or opposition they're going to pose.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们已经看到民主党人停顿了一下，在他们将要采取什么样的抵制或反对行动上难以达成一致。

sentences.en: You've talked a little bit about what's happening publicly.
sentences.zh: 你已经谈了一些关于公开层面正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: I'm curious what has been happening privately because one of my colleagues reported that you were part of a group of Democratic governors in January who privately urged Senator Chuck Schumer to fight harder or at least differently against Trump.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇私下里发生了什么，因为我的一位同事报道说，你是一月份敦促参议员查克·舒默更强硬或至少以不同方式对抗特朗普的民主党州长小组成员之一。

sentences.en: And I'm curious, like, what you were wanting to see that you weren't seeing.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，你当时想看到什么而没有看到的？

sentences.en: I thought at the outset it was very important for leadership in Congress, leadership in Congress, to be out every day with members talking about the things that Trump is doing.
sentences.zh: 我当时认为，国会领导层每天都与议员们讨论特朗普正在做的事情是非常重要的。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because what he's been doing from the beginning is taking away Congress's power.
sentences.zh: 因为他从一开始就在剥夺国会的权力。

sentences.en: Like, all of his action has been him saying basically, Congress, I know, maybe he doesn't know, Congress, you're supposed to make the law.
sentences.zh: 就像他所有的行动基本上都是在说：国会，我知道——也许他不知道——国会，你们本该制定法律。

sentences.en: But, no, I'm making the law now.
sentences.zh: 但现在不，现在由我来制定法律。

sentences.en: I am usurping your authority.
sentences.zh: 我正在篡夺你们的权力。

sentences.en: I am appropriating congressional authority, which is why I thought at the outset,
sentences.zh: 我正在挪用国会的权力，这就是为什么我当时认为，

sentences.en: Congress and members of Congress each day have got to be out there explaining to the American people and everyday Americans, this isn't right, this isn't legal.
sentences.zh: 国会和国会议员们每天都必须站出来向美国人民和普通美国人解释，这不对，这是违法的。

sentences.en: They need to be speaking up to that.
sentences.zh: 他们需要对此大声疾呼。

sentences.en: Do you think the leadership in Congress is the right leadership to enact what you're envisioning?
sentences.zh: 你认为国会的领导层是实现你所设想目标的合适领导层吗？

sentences.en: Look, I'll leave that for members of Congress to decide, right?
sentences.zh: 听着，我把这个问题留给国会议员们去决定，好吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I'm a governor.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我是一名州长。

sentences.en: That's not my call.
sentences.zh: 那不是我的职责范围。

sentences.en: What I can tell you is we need leadership that is aggressive, that is proactive, and that is speaking to everyday Americans.
sentences.zh: 我能告诉你的是，我们需要积极进取、主动出击，并能与普通美国人对话的领导层。

sentences.en: I mean, I think part of the reason— That sounds like you're eliding the question.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为部分原因是——这听起来像是在回避问题。

sentences.en: I don't mean to elide anything.
sentences.zh: 我无意回避任何事情。

sentences.en: I'll say that, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，你知道，

sentences.en: I think part of what got the Democratic Party in trouble this last election is the fact that there was a perception that leaders within the Democratic Party were not actually seeing and feeling people's pain.
sentences.zh: 我认为导致民主党在上届选举中陷入困境的部分原因是，人们认为民主党内的领导人并没有真正看到和感受到民众的痛苦。

sentences.en: I think there's a perception that—and I think it lived out to a certain extent among Democratic leadership that they just didn't have their finger on the pulse.
sentences.zh: 我认为存在一种看法——而且我认为在某种程度上在民主党领导层中也确实存在——他们没有把握住脉搏。

sentences.en: You know, they're talking about issues that weren't bread and butter, core economic issues that resonate.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们谈论的问题不是那些能引起共鸣的、核心的经济民生问题。

sentences.en: They allowed themselves in some ways to be caricatured as only caring about X, Y, and Z issue, which isn't true, by the way.
sentences.zh: 他们在某种程度上让自己被刻画成只关心X、Y和Z问题的人，顺便说一句，这并非事实。

sentences.en: One of the reasons I wanted to talk to you is that I was told by quite a few Democrats that you are very influential in the party beyond your state.
sentences.zh: 我之所以想和你谈谈，原因之一是不少民主党人告诉我，你在党内跨州的影响力非常大。

sentences.en: And so, as you have been having these conversations about moving the party forward, I did want to get your temperature on just the Democratic brand writ large,
sentences.zh: 所以，既然你一直在进行关于推动党向前发展的对话，我确实想了解你对整个民主党品牌的看法，

sentences.en: because polling is showing that the Democratic brand is really underwater, regardless of what's happening with Donald Trump and what's happening in the White House.
sentences.zh: 因为民调显示，无论唐纳德·特朗普和白宫发生了什么，民主党的品牌形象确实非常糟糕。

sentences.en: The losses were steep in the last election.
sentences.zh: 在上届选举中，损失惨重。

sentences.en: You are the governor of a solidly blue state.
sentences.zh: 你是深蓝州（民主党铁票仓）的州长。

sentences.en: What was your big takeaway about why the Democrats did so badly?
sentences.zh: 关于为什么民主党表现得如此糟糕，你最大的收获是什么？

sentences.en: Well, there's definitely a brand problem.
sentences.zh: 嗯，品牌确实存在问题。

sentences.en: There's a big brand problem.
sentences.zh: 存在严重的品牌问题。

sentences.en: And, you know, I am—I don't pretend to speak for the party, but I can tell you as a Democratic leader what I'm going to do.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我——我不假装代表全党发言，但我可以以民主党领导人的身份告诉你我打算做什么。

sentences.en: I'm going to focus on driving what I believe is a Democratic message.
sentences.zh: 我将专注于推动我认为是民主党的核心信息。

sentences.en: Let's take this moment and redefine the brand.
sentences.zh: 让我们抓住这个时刻，重新定义这个品牌。

sentences.en: To me, the Democratic brand should be about delivering for everyday Americans.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，民主党品牌应该致力于为普通美国人谋福祉。

sentences.en: We have the chance to do that with the foil of Donald Trump, cutting all these programs, cutting our military, for God's sakes,
sentences.zh: 我们有机会利用唐纳德·特朗普作为反面教材来做到这一点，他削减了所有这些项目，甚至削减了我们的军费，天哪，

sentences.en: to free up funding that'll pay for the tax cuts he wants to give to billionaires.
sentences.zh: 为了腾出资金来支付他想给亿万富翁的减税政策。

sentences.en: So what can we do as Democrats?
sentences.zh: 那么作为民主党人，我们能做什么？

sentences.en: Where do I think we need to go?
sentences.zh: 我认为我们需要走向何方？

sentences.en: If I was going to offer advice, it's to every day tack towards and have your North Star be.
sentences.zh: 如果我要提供建议，那就是每天都要向这个目标靠拢，并把你的北极星定为：

sentences.en: What am I doing for everyday Americans?
sentences.zh: 我为普通美国人做了什么？

sentences.en: But I'm curious, Governor, because, I mean, I think if you talk to any Democrat, the Biden administration on down, they would say that that was their focus.
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇，州长，因为，我的意思是，我认为如果你和任何民主党人交谈，从拜登政府往下，他们都会说这就是他们的重点。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, they would say that that is precisely what they did during the last four years.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，他们会说这正是他们在过去四年中所做的。

sentences.en: They really tried to build up the economy out of a massive recession.
sentences.zh: 他们确实试图在巨大的经济衰退中重建经济。

sentences.en: They, you know, tried to tackle inflation, et cetera, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 他们，你知道，试图解决通货膨胀等等等等。

sentences.en: I am curious how you see that being different than what happened before.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你认为这与之前发生的事情有何不同。

sentences.en: I think there are differences.
sentences.zh: 我认为确实存在差异。

sentences.en: I told President Biden directly a few years ago that he needed to be active on the border, that he should take executive action on the border.
sentences.zh: 几年前我直接告诉拜登总统，他需要在边境问题上采取积极行动，他应该在边境问题上采取行政措施。

sentences.en: OK, I knew that as an attorney general and as a former prosecutor there, there were things that could have been done.
sentences.zh: 好的，作为总检察长和前检察官，我知道有些事情是可以做的。

sentences.en: And I wish that he had done that.
sentences.zh: 我希望他当时那样做了。

sentences.en: So I also think it's important to fight back.
sentences.zh: 所以我也认为反击很重要。

sentences.en: You know, when there was all this talk and denigration of DEI, I don't know why the response wasn't, you know what,
sentences.zh: 你知道，当有那么多关于DEI（多元、公平与包容）的讨论和诋毁时，我不知道为什么回应不是，你知道吗，

sentences.en: it's actually good to have women and people of color in the military.
sentences.zh: 在军队中有女性和有色人种实际上是件好事。

sentences.en: It's good to have women and people of color in the workforce.
sentences.zh: 在劳动力队伍中有女性和有色人种是件好事。

sentences.en: It's good to have women and people of color going to colleges and universities.
sentences.zh: 有女性和有色人种进入学院和大学是件好事。

sentences.en: Like, what's wrong with that?
sentences.zh: 这有什么错吗？

sentences.en: And put it back on them instead of it being allowed to be this attenuated caricatured conversation about, quote, DEI, you know.
sentences.zh: 把问题抛回给他们，而不是任由其变成一场关于所谓“DEI”的、被淡化和歪曲的对话，你知道。

sentences.en: And some of it's about how you match the mischaracterization and how you match really offensive but effective attempts to strike down certain things or to pit people against each other.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分在于你如何应对这种歪曲，以及你如何应对那些虽然冒犯但却有效的、旨在推翻某些事物或挑拨离间的企图。

sentences.en: That's the thing.
sentences.zh: 关键就在这里。

sentences.en: If you're getting bullied and you don't respond with force, the bully is going to win always.
sentences.zh: 如果你受到欺凌却不以强硬手段回应，欺凌者永远会赢。

sentences.en: And we need people who are able to do that and to do that effectively and in a way that shows that we're actually aligned with the majority of Americans on this.
sentences.zh: 我们需要能够做到这一点的人，并且要有效地做到这一点，以表明我们在这一点上确实与大多数美国人站在一起。

sentences.en: And, you know, that I think that's a work in progress.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为这还需要努力。

sentences.en: Do you blame part of the failure to defend the Democratic brand, to articulate the vision on the Biden administration?
sentences.zh: 你是否将未能捍卫民主党品牌、未能阐明愿景的部分责任归咎于拜登政府？

sentences.en: Because you were the first Democratic governor to publicly urge President Biden to exit the race in July of last year.
sentences.zh: 因为你是去年七月第一位公开敦促拜登总统退选的民主党州长。

sentences.en: I mean, how much do you think it hurt the party in voters' eyes that it seemed like Democrats were sort of hiding President Biden's failing acuity?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你认为民主党似乎在掩盖拜登总统日益衰退的敏锐度，这在选民眼中对党造成了多大的伤害？

sentences.en: I mean, I think that President Biden, the Biden administration did so much for this country and pulled us through a pandemic, pulled us out of a really dark economic time,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为拜登总统、拜登政府为这个国家做了很多，带领我们度过了疫情，带领我们走出了非常黑暗的经济时期，

sentences.en: got us on really solid footing, did some incredible things.
sentences.zh: 让我们走上了非常稳固的基础，做了一些不可思议的事情。

sentences.en: Because I think the party was hampered by having President Biden as the communicator in chief, if I'm being honest, okay?
sentences.zh: 因为如果说实话，我认为党因为有拜登总统作为首席沟通者而受到了阻碍，好吗？

sentences.en: He wasn't the strongest communicator in chief.
sentences.zh: 他并不是最强有力的首席沟通者。

sentences.en: And that hurt us because they weren't able to sell all of the important accomplishments that were actually, in fact, happening effectively or as effectively.
sentences.zh: 这伤害了我们，因为他们无法有效地——或者说无法足够有效地——推销所有实际上正在发生的重大成就。

sentences.en: And that definitely hurt.
sentences.zh: 这绝对造成了伤害。

sentences.en: Do you think the party is adequately reckoning now with the effects of what happened, though?
sentences.zh: 你认为该党现在是否在充分反思所发生事情的影响？

sentences.en: Because I just saw one of Biden's senior advisors, Mike Donilon, say that the Democratic Party, quote,
sentences.zh: 因为我刚刚看到拜登的一位高级顾问迈克·多尼隆说，民主党，引用他的话，

sentences.en: lost its mind after Biden's poor debate and basically threw an incumbent under the bus and that cost them the election.
sentences.zh: 在拜登糟糕的辩论表现后失去了理智，基本上把一位现任总统抛弃了，这让他们输掉了选举。

sentences.en: I don't, I hadn't seen that comment.
sentences.zh: 我不，我没看到那个评论。

sentences.en: Are we grappling with what happened and having to deal with it right now?
sentences.zh: 我们现在是否正在努力应对所发生的事情并处理它？

sentences.en: You better believe it.
sentences.zh: 你最好相信我们正在这样做。

sentences.en: We've got Donald Trump in the White House.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普现在在白宫。

sentences.en: But, you know, I've talked before about this, you know, and my views about President Biden.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我之前谈过这个，你知道，以及我对拜登总统的看法。

sentences.en: And I think it was very hard for Kamala Harris, who I thought ran a fantastic campaign,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为对于卡玛拉·哈里斯来说非常困难，我认为她进行了一场精彩的竞选，

sentences.en: to be able to overcome the disadvantage at the time and within the time that she was allotted.
sentences.zh: 要在当时的情况下和她所被分配的时间内克服这种劣势。

sentences.en: And I think it would have been a different story if the president had decided a few years ago that he was going to do what he said he would do, which is to serve one term.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为如果总统几年前决定做他所说的那样，即只担任一届任期，那故事就会是另一番景象了。

sentences.en: And then we'd have the opportunity for, you know, full engagement in a primary and the like.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就有机会进行，你知道，初选中的充分参与等等。

sentences.en: That didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 那并没有发生。

sentences.en: I have no interest in further spending time on it, revisiting history.
sentences.zh: 我没兴趣再花时间去重温历史了。

sentences.en: I'm focused on the now.
sentences.zh: 我专注于当下。

sentences.en: After the break, I asked Governor Healy about the migrant crisis that has played out during her time in office.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我问了希利州长关于她在任期间发生的移民危机。

sentences.en: And we talked more about the Trump administration's campaign against diversity, equity and inclusion.
sentences.zh: 我们还谈到了特朗普政府针对多元、公平与包容（DEI）的运动。

sentences.en: It's interesting at a time when the co-president, Elon Musk, is giving us Hitler salutes, right?
sentences.zh: 在一个“共同总统”埃隆·马斯克向我们行希特勒礼的时候，这很有趣，对吧？

sentences.en: And espousing anti-Semitic things.
sentences.zh: 而且还在宣扬反犹太主义的东西。

sentences.en: And I just find it ironic that it's like we're going to have this debate over DEI, whether it's like effective.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得讽刺的是，我们竟然要就DEI是否有效进行这种辩论。

sentences.en: All the while, this is going on over here.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这边却在发生这种事。

sentences.en: I mean, like, seriously?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，认真的吗？

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: Governor Healy, the number two issue in your state, according to polling, is immigration, which is something that has plagued Democrats in the last election.
sentences.zh: 希利州长，根据民调，你所在州的第二大问题是移民，这也是在上届选举中困扰民主党的问题。

sentences.en: 2023 was the year where states like yours saw a big surge.
sentences.zh: 2023年是像你这样的州出现大规模激增的一年。

sentences.en: That's also when you became governor.
sentences.zh: 那也是你成为州长的时候。

sentences.en: Can you tell me how you've seen this particular issue play out?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我你是如何看待这个问题发展的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, you're right about the timing of it.
sentences.zh: 是的，关于时间点，你说得对。

sentences.en: I think that in the year before I took office, we'd seen the first influx of migrants into certain states.
sentences.zh: 我想在我上任的前一年，我们就已经看到第一批移民涌入某些州了。

sentences.en: We're home to a significant Haitian diaspora here in Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 马萨诸塞州是大量海地侨民的家园。

sentences.en: And so there are a number of Haitians coming into Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 因此，有许多海地人来到马萨诸塞州。

sentences.en: This was something that I inherited.
sentences.zh: 这是我接手的烂摊子。

sentences.en: It was underway when I became governor, and it only grew during the first year or so of my administration.
sentences.zh: 在我担任州长时，这股浪潮已经在进行中，并且在我执政的第一年左右进一步加剧了。

sentences.en: It goes back to something fundamental.
sentences.zh: 这归根结底是一个根本性问题。

sentences.en: We have not had comprehensive immigration reform in this country.
sentences.zh: 我们国家一直没有进行全面的移民改革。

sentences.en: We need it.
sentences.zh: 我们需要改革。

sentences.en: I was so upset when Donald Trump killed that border bill, which would have provided a pathway
sentences.zh: 当唐纳德·特朗普否决了那项边境法案时，我感到非常沮丧，因为该法案本可以提供一条途径，

sentences.en: for our dreamers, would have provided a pathway for people who are living here, working here, raising kids here, paying taxes here to become citizens.
sentences.zh: 为我们的“追梦人”提供途径，为那些住在这里、在这里工作、在这里抚养孩子、在这里纳税的人提供成为公民的途径。

sentences.en: It also would have provided the kinds of resources for more border agents, more immigration judges,
sentences.zh: 它本还可以提供各种资源，增加边境特工、移民法官，

sentences.en: more resources at intercepting fentanyl and other drugs from coming into the country.
sentences.zh: 并提供更多资源来拦截芬太尼和其他毒品进入我国。

sentences.en: It's been a challenging situation to say the leaSt.
sentences.zh: 退一步说，这确实是一个充满挑战的局面。

sentences.en: And my frustration has been, you know, as a state governor, I am inheriting the problems
sentences.zh: 我的挫败感在于，作为州长，我继承了

sentences.en: caused by federal inaction and federal inaction specifically on the border and on immigration.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府不作为所导致的问题，特别是在边境和移民问题上的不作为。

sentences.en: One of the most visible strategies Republican governors adopted during the height of the migrant crisis was sending buses and planes of migrants to blue states like yours.
sentences.zh: 在移民危机最严重的时候，共和党州长们采取的最显眼的策略之一，就是把载满移民的巴士和飞机送到像你们这样的蓝色州。

sentences.en: Very memorably, Martha's Vineyard, it was a stunt, but you could argue that it worked.
sentences.zh: 最令人难忘的就是玛莎葡萄园岛事件，那是一场作秀，但你也可以说它奏效了。

sentences.en: It made immigration enforcement into a blue state issue, which it had not been.
sentences.zh: 它把移民执法变成了一个蓝色州的问题，而这在以前并不是。

sentences.en: Shouldn't it always have been, though?
sentences.zh: 但难道这不应该一直都是个问题吗？

sentences.en: I mean, is it not fair to say that Democrats really did not take this issue seriously?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，说民主党人真的没有认真对待这个问题，难道不公平吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't see it that way.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不这么看。

sentences.en: I think Democrats in Congress were the ones who, time after time, were pushing for immigration reform.
sentences.zh: 我认为国会的民主党人才是那些一次又一次推动移民改革的人。

sentences.en: And that's what I saw.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所看到的。

sentences.en: It was a stunt.
sentences.zh: 那是一场作秀。

sentences.en: It was a stunt what happened.
sentences.zh: 发生的事情就是一场作秀。

sentences.en: I think it, you know, the buses, the buses to New York, to Illinois, to Colorado.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道，那些开往纽约、伊利诺伊州、科罗拉多州的巴士。

sentences.en: I think the Republicans did a really effective job of making this an issue and, frankly, of scaring a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 我认为共和党人在把这变成一个议题方面做得非常有效，坦率地说，他们也吓到了很多人。

sentences.en: Massachusetts, we're ranked the safest state in the country, okay?
sentences.zh: 马萨诸塞州，我们被评为全国最安全的州，好吗？

sentences.en: It doesn't mean that we don't have ongoing law enforcement work.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着我们没有持续的执法工作。

sentences.en: We do, and that's the reason why it is so safe.
sentences.zh: 我们有，这就是为什么这里如此安全的原因。

sentences.en: We just had a takedown of a gang here a week or two ago, including a gang that has recently been cited by the new ICE director.
sentences.zh: 就在一两周前，我们刚刚捣毁了一个帮派，其中包括新任移民及海关执法局（ICE）局长最近点名提到的一个帮派。

sentences.en: So, you know, it's also the case, like, here, you know, with the migrants who came in.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这里的情况也是如此，你知道，对于那些进来的移民来说。

sentences.en: And by the way, they were fleeing the worst conditions imaginable, right?
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，他们是在逃离难以想象的最恶劣的生存环境，对吧？

sentences.en: I saw them.
sentences.zh: 我亲眼看到了他们。

sentences.en: I met with many of them.
sentences.zh: 我见过他们中的许多人。

sentences.en: We got them work authorizations.
sentences.zh: 我们为他们获得了工作许可。

sentences.en: They're working.
sentences.zh: 他们正在工作。

sentences.en: They're paying taxes.
sentences.zh: 他们正在纳税。

sentences.en: These are all people with lawful status now.
sentences.zh: 这些人现在都有合法的身份。

sentences.en: Their kids are going to school.
sentences.zh: 他们的孩子正在上学。

sentences.en: They're contributing to our economy.
sentences.zh: 他们正在为我们的经济做出贡献。

sentences.en: They're working in our hospitals and nursing homes.
sentences.zh: 他们在我们的医院和疗养院工作。

sentences.en: That's what I chose to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我选择做的事情。

sentences.en: Ron DeSantis chose to put people on a plane and use them.
sentences.zh: 罗恩·德桑蒂斯选择把人送上飞机并利用他们。

sentences.en: Greg Abbott chose to put people on buses and use them to make a point.
sentences.zh: 格雷格·阿博特选择把人送上巴士，并利用他们来达到某种目的。

sentences.en: I'll tell you the difference of being a Democratic governor.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你作为一名民主党州长的区别。

sentences.en: We actually found a way to take care of these people, get them jobs, get them working, and get them contributing to our economies.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上找到了照顾这些人的方法，为他们提供了工作，让他们就业，并让他们为我们的经济做出贡献。

sentences.en: And yet a poll just came out from UMass and WCBV showing that immigration is very important to people here.
sentences.zh: 然而，马萨诸塞大学和WCBV刚刚发布的一项民调显示，移民问题对这里的人们来说非常重要。

sentences.en: And a majority of voters don't approve of the way that you've handled it.
sentences.zh: 而且大多数选民不赞成你处理这个问题的方式。

sentences.en: Why do you think that is?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是为什么？

sentences.en: There's just a lack of truSt.
sentences.zh: 只是缺乏信任。

sentences.en: There's a lack of truSt.
sentences.zh: 缺乏信任。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's hard to overcome the fear mongering that's gone on.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，很难克服那些一直存在的恐慌言论。

sentences.en: One, the number of people in what are our emergency shelter system here in Massachusetts now.
sentences.zh: 第一，现在我们马萨诸塞州紧急避难系统中的人数。

sentences.en: See, to zoom out, we're the only state in the country that has what's called a right to shelter law that houses women and children and families who are experiencing homelessness.
sentences.zh: 你看，从宏观来看，我们是全国唯一一个拥有所谓“庇护权法”的州，该法为无家可归的妇女、儿童和家庭提供住所。

sentences.en: And as a result, the law has required us to take in numbers, including migrants who've arrived here as homeless.
sentences.zh: 因此，法律要求我们接收包括作为无家可归者抵达此地的移民在内的人数。

sentences.en: I've recently made proposals to the legislature to change that.
sentences.zh: 我最近已向立法机关提出修改建议。

sentences.en: But it's been a challenging situation.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是一个充满挑战的局面。

sentences.en: I'll say, though, that even within that system, the majority of folks in that system are actually
sentences.zh: 不过，我要说的是，即使在那个系统中，其中大多数人实际上是

sentences.en: Massachusetts families.
sentences.zh: 马萨诸塞州的家庭。

sentences.en: They're not new immigrant families, okay?
sentences.zh: 他们不是新移民家庭，好吗？

sentences.en: But it's about what the public perception is.
sentences.zh: 但问题在于公众的看法。

sentences.en: And all I can do is try to manage my way through it.
sentences.zh: 我所能做的就是尽力去管理好这一切。

sentences.en: I mean, you've said before that the right to shelter law wasn't actually made to help waves and waves of people sort of settle here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你之前说过，“庇护权法”实际上并不是为了帮助一波又一波的人在这里定居而制定的。

sentences.en: And you are now seeking to change it.
sentences.zh: 而你现在正寻求修改它。

sentences.en: I am curious, why did you come to that decision?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，你为什么做出那个决定？

sentences.en: Because I think what you're trying to do, among other things, is require anyone seeking shelter to prove that they're in the country legally.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为你试图做的事情，除其他事项外，是要求任何寻求庇护的人证明他们是合法入境的。

sentences.en: Is that one of the changes that you're trying to make to the law?
sentences.zh: 这是你试图对法律做出的修改之一吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I think that what we're focused on is really about your—are you—have you been living in Massachusetts?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为我们关注的重点实际上是关于你的——你是——你一直住在马萨诸塞州吗？

sentences.en: Or did you just get evicted from your apartment in Pennsylvania and you got on a bus and drove up here?
sentences.zh: 还是你刚被宾夕法尼亚州的公寓驱逐，然后就坐上巴士开车来到这里？

sentences.en: Like, our law is meant to actually take of families who, for one reason or another, in
sentences.zh: 我们的法律旨在真正照顾那些因为这样或那样的原因，在

sentences.en: Massachusetts became homeless, not to be a refuge for people from other states who sadly, and
sentences.zh: 马萨诸塞州变得无家可归的家庭，而不是成为其他州人们的避难所，他们很遗憾，而且

sentences.en: with compassion, I say this, became homeless and then come to Massachusetts to get housing.
sentences.zh: 我怀着同情心说这句话，他们变得无家可归，然后来到马萨诸塞州寻求住房。

sentences.en: That's not the point of the law.
sentences.zh: 那不是法律的初衷。

sentences.en: As you know, Trump's borders are Tom Homan singled Boston out at CPAC last week.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，特朗普的边境事务负责人汤姆·霍曼上周在CPAC会议上特别点名了波士顿。

sentences.en: He called out Boston's police commissioner who said because of state law, he won't be enforcing immigration orders against migrants.
sentences.zh: 他公开指责波士顿警察局长，后者曾表示由于州法律，他不会针对移民执行移民令。

sentences.en: Homan then said, and I'm quoting here, I'm coming to Boston and bringing hell with me.
sentences.zh: 霍曼随后说，我引用一下，“我要去波士顿，并带去地狱。”

sentences.en: And I'm wondering what your response to that is.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你对此有何回应。

sentences.en: First of all, I don't really even know what he's talking about, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 首先，老实说，我甚至不知道他在说什么。

sentences.en: Again, I'm somebody whose state police regularly work with Homeland Security, ATF, FBI, DEA, on
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我的州警察经常与国土安全部、烟酒枪炮及爆炸物管理局（ATF）、联邦调查局（FBI）、缉毒局（DEA）合作，

sentences.en: the investigation and prosecution of folks, including folks who are undocumented, who have and are committing crimes, drug trafficking, gun trafficking, human trafficking.
sentences.zh: 调查和起诉那些人，包括那些无证件的人，他们已经或正在犯罪，如毒品贩运、枪支贩运、人口贩运。

sentences.en: That was the way before Trump.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普之前就是这样。

sentences.en: It will be the way after Trump.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普之后也会是这样。

sentences.en: So I don't really know what he's referring to in terms of, or why he singled out Boston.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的不知道他指的是什么，或者他为什么要特别点名波士顿。

sentences.en: Again, Boston is- I think your police commissioner said basically that they weren't going to help ICE remove people with orders of removal, as happens in many sanctuary cities.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，波士顿是——我想你们的警察局长基本上是说，他们不会协助ICE驱逐那些有驱逐令的人，就像许多庇护城市发生的那样。

sentences.en: We're not- Boston's- that's the thing.
sentences.zh: 我们不是——波士顿——这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: There's this- I think there's a lot of talk and semantics out there, and this guy, Holman,
sentences.zh: 我认为外面有很多言论和语义上的争论，而这个叫霍曼的家伙，

sentences.en: is just, you know, as a lot in the Trump administration do, just making up a bunch of stuff and trying to start something, trying to pick a fight, okay?
sentences.zh: 只是，你知道，正如特朗普政府中的许多人所做的那样，只是编造了一堆东西，试图挑起事端，试图找茬，好吗？

sentences.en: So, look, that's not productive, okay?
sentences.zh: 所以，听着，那没有成效，好吗？

sentences.en: Because as a former law enforcement official, if you care about law enforcement, the best
sentences.zh: 因为作为一名前执法官员，如果你关心执法，那么

sentences.en: way to secure the safety and well-being of community states, our nation, is for local, state, and federal law enforcement to work together.
sentences.zh: 确保社区、州和我们国家安全与福祉的最好方法，就是让地方、州和联邦执法部门共同努力。

sentences.en: So it seems to me you shouldn't be threatening to bring- what was it?
sentences.zh: 所以在我看来，你不应该威胁要带来——那是什么？

sentences.en: Hell?
sentences.zh: 地狱？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Hell.
sentences.zh: 地狱。

sentences.en: Okay, whatever.
sentences.zh: 好吧，随便吧。

sentences.en: No, you should come here with support and resources, right?
sentences.zh: 不，你应该带着支持和资源来到这里，对吧？

sentences.en: To help us address any public safety issues we're experiencing.
sentences.zh: 来帮助我们解决我们正在经历的任何公共安全问题。

sentences.en: You should do that with other states.
sentences.zh: 你应该对其他州也这样做。

sentences.en: And I can tell you that Massachusetts law enforcement, state and local, continue to work with federal law enforcement when it comes to the investigation and the prosecution and
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，马萨诸塞州的执法部门，无论是州还是地方，在调查、起诉和

sentences.en: the apprehension of criminals.
sentences.zh: 逮捕罪犯方面，继续与联邦执法部门合作。

sentences.en: The real thing that's going on at ICE is that the numbers have gone down at the border.
sentences.zh: ICE真正发生的事情是边境的人数已经下降了。

sentences.en: The number- the crossings at the border were going down during the end of the Biden administration, in fact.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在拜登政府末期，边境的越境人数一直在下降。

sentences.en: And so I think they're scrambling, you know, to figure out how they can keep this going.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们正在手忙脚乱地想办法如何让这种局面持续下去。

sentences.en: Don't- wasn't there reports just- just today of the number of National Guard people on the border sitting around doing nothing?
sentences.zh: 不是——今天不是有报道说边境上的国民警卫队人数都在闲着没事干吗？

sentences.en: I mean, let's put people to work.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，让我们让人干活吧。

sentences.en: You know, we've got governors who are dealing with severe floods, severe fires.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们有州长正在处理严重的洪水、严重的火灾。

sentences.en: There's plenty of places that we need federal resources and help, as states, as states.
sentences.zh: 作为州，我们有很多地方需要联邦的资源和帮助。

sentences.en: Would you meet Tom Homan if he came?
sentences.zh: 如果汤姆·霍曼来了，你会见他吗？

sentences.en: Of course I would.
sentences.zh: 我当然会。

sentences.en: Yeah, it sounds like I might need to explain a few things to him as somebody who investigated and prosecuted crimes, including with federal authorities, for a number of years here.
sentences.zh: 是的，听起来我可能需要向他解释一些事情，作为一个在这里调查和起诉犯罪（包括与联邦当局合作）多年的人。

sentences.en: Maybe he doesn't have the benefit of that knowledge.
sentences.zh: 也许他没有那种知识储备。

sentences.en: Another place where the federal and state governments are linked is on education.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府和州政府联系在一起的另一个领域是教育。

sentences.en: President Trump has made rolling back DEI, which is diversity, equity and inclusion, central to his political project.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统已将撤销DEI（即多元、公平和包容）作为其政治项目的核心。

sentences.en: He has said now that he's going to be cutting federal funding for schools that include it.
sentences.zh: 他现在说，他将削减那些包含DEI项目的学校的联邦资金。

sentences.en: We don't know exactly what that means.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道这具体意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's sort of open to interpretation.
sentences.zh: 这有点任由解读。

sentences.en: You've said that Massachusetts schools are going to stay true to themselves.
sentences.zh: 你说过马萨诸塞州的学校将保持本色。

sentences.en: What do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: We're going to keep doing what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 我们将继续做我们正在做的事情。

sentences.en: Look, I am the first woman in Massachusetts history to be elected governor.
sentences.zh: 听着，我是马萨诸塞州历史上第一位当选州长的女性。

sentences.en: I happen to be the first gay person elected governor.
sentences.zh: 我恰好是第一位当选州长的同性恋者。

sentences.en: I don't know where I would be if I didn't have support and legal protections against discrimination my entire life.
sentences.zh: 我不知道如果我一生中没有得到支持和反歧视的法律保护，我会是什么样子。

sentences.en: I was born in 1971, so just around the time of Title IX.
sentences.zh: 我出生于1971年，正好是在《教育法修正案第九条》（Title IX）出台前后。

sentences.en: And I had a career as an athlete and a professional athlete, basketball player, before I went to law
sentences.zh: 在进入法学院之前，我曾是一名运动员和职业运动员、篮球运动员，我想到所有这些对我作为一个女性来说成为可能，是因为有州和联邦法律规定，你知道吗，我们应该公平对待每个人。

sentences.en: school, I think about all that was made possible for me as a woman because there were state and federal laws in place that said, you know what, we should treat everybody fairly.
sentences.zh: 这与你的性别无关，你知道，与你的肤色、你的宗教信仰无关。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter your gender, you know, it doesn't matter the color of your skin, your religion.
sentences.zh: 我认为那是一个美国原则，即使这意味着失去联邦资金，也不能放弃这一点。

sentences.en: I think that's an American principle, not giving up on that, even if it means pulling federal funding.
sentences.zh: 我只是认为需要有足够多的人继续站出来，说明为什么那是一件如此糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: I just think enough people need to continue to speak out and speak to why that's such a bad thing.
sentences.zh: 去和任何首席执行官、大型财富500强公司谈谈。

sentences.en: Talk to any CEO, major, you know, Fortune 500 company.
sentences.zh: 他们会告诉你，当房间里有更多样性时，他们的底线，从金钱角度来看，会更好。

sentences.en: They'll tell you that their bottom line, dollar-wise, does better when there's more diversity in the room.
sentences.zh: 但许多这些——

sentences.en: But many of these—
sentences.zh: 那不是一件坏事。

sentences.en: That's not a bad thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件好事。

sentences.en: It's a good thing.
sentences.zh: 它让我们变得更强大。

sentences.en: It's made us stronger.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多这些公司正在放弃他们的DEI项目。

sentences.en: Many of these companies, though, are ditching their DEI prograMs.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么。

sentences.en: And I don't know why.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么。

sentences.en: I don't know why.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想我知道为什么。

sentences.en: I mean, I think I know why.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们感受到了埃隆·马斯克的威胁。

sentences.en: I think that they feel the threat of Elon Musk.
sentences.zh: 他们感受到了唐纳德·特朗普的威胁，这在某种程度上是一回事。

sentences.en: They feel the threat of Donald Trump, which is sort of one and the same.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这就是他们所做出的反应。

sentences.en: But I think that that's what they're responding to.
sentences.zh: 这不对。

sentences.en: It's not right.
sentences.zh: 这对这个国家来说不是赢家。

sentences.en: It's not a winner for this country.
sentences.zh: 通过消除或做一些阻碍这个国家人才和个人成功的事情，并不能帮助我们在全球范围内更具竞争力。

sentences.en: It's not going to help us be more competitive around the world by removing or doing things that hinder talent in this country and the success of individuals.
sentences.zh: 那你认为为什么我们看到了对DEI的如此强烈的抵制？

sentences.en: Why do you think we're seeing such a backlash to DEI, though?
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们表达了他们确实感到那种强制性的多元、公平和包容。

sentences.en: You know, people have expressed that they do feel that sort of mandated diversity, equity, and inclusion.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这对种族和族裔之间的关系没有好处。

sentences.en: They feel that it hasn't been beneficial to relations between races and ethnicities.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，特别是在右翼有一种感觉，认为这已经变成了一种左翼的正统观念。

sentences.en: And that, you know, there is a feeling specifically on the right that this has become a sort of left-wing orthodoxy.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，特别是在右翼有一种感觉，认为这已经变成了一种左翼的正统观念。

sentences.en: You know, it's interesting at a time when the co-president, you know, Elon Musk, is giving us Hitler salutes, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这很有趣，在联合主席，也就是埃隆·马斯克，向我们行希特勒礼的时候，对吧？

sentences.en: And espousing anti-Semitic things.
sentences.zh: 而且还发表反犹太言论。

sentences.en: And I just find it ironic that it's like we're going to have this debate over DEI and whether it's like effective all the while this is going on over here.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得讽刺，好像我们要在DEI（多元、公平和包容）问题上进行辩论，讨论它是否有效，而与此同时，这种事情却在发生。

sentences.en: I mean, like, seriously?
sentences.zh: 我是说，认真的吗？

sentences.en: So we can talk about DEI and whether there are some approaches or aspects that people want to look at more or maybe need reform or, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我们可以谈论DEI，谈论人们是否想要更多地审视某些方法或方面，或者是否需要改革，或者，你知道，

sentences.en: there should be more flexibility in certain things.
sentences.zh: 在某些事情上应该有更多的灵活性。

sentences.en: But do not tell me that we are going to condone and go down a path in government or in corporate America that says women and people of color are no longer at the table.
sentences.zh: 但别告诉我，我们要纵容并走上一条政府或美国企业界的道路，说女性和有色人种不再有一席之地了。

sentences.en: And not only no longer at the table, but will not be supported anywhere along the way.
sentences.zh: 不仅不再有一席之地，而且在整个过程中都不会得到任何支持。

sentences.en: I think, unfortunately, what's happened in the moment, we've seen a lot of capitulation.
sentences.zh: 我认为不幸的是，在当下，我们看到了很多屈服。

sentences.en: We've seen a lot of people trying to hedge their bets.
sentences.zh: 我们看到很多人试图两头下注。

sentences.en: You mean to tell me that's good for America?
sentences.zh: 你是想告诉我这对美国有好处吗？

sentences.en: Come on.
sentences.zh: 得了吧。

sentences.en: You were, as you mentioned, the country's first openly gay attorney general.
sentences.zh: 正如你提到的，你是美国第一位公开同性恋身份的总检察长。

sentences.en: Prior to that, you worked in the Civil Rights Division of the AG's office, where you led the first successful challenge to the Defense of Marriage Act.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，你在总检察长办公室的民权部门工作，在那里你领导了对《捍卫婚姻法案》的首次成功挑战。

sentences.en: I sued President Obama.
sentences.zh: 我起诉了奥巴马总统。

sentences.en: You did.
sentences.zh: 你确实起诉了。

sentences.en: There is some concern among Democrats that after Roe v.
sentences.zh: 民主党人中存在一些担忧，即在罗诉韦德案之后，

sentences.en: Wade, we are going to see Obergefell, the Supreme Court's decision that made gay marriage legal at the federal level, overturned next.
sentences.zh: 我们接下来会看到奥贝格费尔案，即最高法院在联邦层面使同性婚姻合法化的裁决，被推翻。

sentences.en: Do you worry about that?
sentences.zh: 你担心这个吗？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我担心。

sentences.en: I mean, how can you not?
sentences.zh: 我是说，怎么能不担心呢？

sentences.en: The Supreme Court constituted as it is.
sentences.zh: 最高法院现在的构成就是这样。

sentences.en: I mean, how can you not?
sentences.zh: 我是说，怎么能不担心呢？

sentences.en: It seems like anything is possible, is conceivable.
sentences.zh: 看起来一切皆有可能，一切皆可想象。

sentences.en: Now, you know, it is, again, up to everyone to be able to speak out and articulate why it is so important to hold on to precedent.
sentences.zh: 现在，你知道，这再次取决于每个人能否站出来，阐明为什么坚持先例如此重要。

sentences.en: I thought we'd done that with Roe, right?
sentences.zh: 我以为我们在罗诉韦德案上已经做到了，对吧？

sentences.en: And look what happened there.
sentences.zh: 看看那里发生了什么。

sentences.en: And there was a huge amount of fury after Roe fell, but that dissipated.
sentences.zh: 罗诉韦德案被推翻后，曾有巨大的愤怒，但后来消散了。

sentences.en: A lot of Democrats thought in this election that Roe was going to be something that was going to galvanize people, and it didn't enough.
sentences.zh: 很多民主党人认为在这次选举中，罗诉韦德案会成为激励人们的事情，但并没有起到足够的作用。

sentences.en: And so I guess when you look at, you know, marriage equality, does it seem more imminent to you that perhaps people won't stand up for the things that seem to have been settled?
sentences.zh: 所以我猜，当你审视婚姻平权时，你是否觉得人们可能不会捍卫那些似乎已经定论的事情，这种可能性更迫在眉睫了？

sentences.en: I guess I'd unpack that a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我想我得稍微拆解一下这个问题。

sentences.en: I think if you look at Roe and the aftermath of Roe, right, what did I do right away as governor?
sentences.zh: 我认为如果你看看罗诉韦德案及其后果，对吧，我作为州长立刻做了什么？

sentences.en: Stockpile Mifepristone, right?
sentences.zh: 囤积米非司酮，对吧？

sentences.en: We passed a shield law here to protect patients and providers.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里通过了一项保护法，以保护病人和医疗提供者。

sentences.en: Other governors took similar actions.
sentences.zh: 其他州长也采取了类似的行动。

sentences.en: We saw races in states over Roe, over the abortion issue, where abortion rights won time after time after time.
sentences.zh: 我们看到各州围绕罗诉韦德案、围绕堕胎问题进行了竞选，堕胎权一次又一次地获胜。

sentences.en: Where it didn't carry the day or carry the entirety of an election, determinative of an election, the only one was the presidential.
sentences.zh: 在没有决定性影响或没有决定整个选举结果的地方，唯一例外的是总统选举。

sentences.en: And I just think that abortion rights wasn't enough.
sentences.zh: 我只是认为堕胎权还不够。

sentences.en: To overcome the perception of weak leadership by the Biden administration on immigration, on the economy,
sentences.zh: 不足以克服拜登政府在移民、经济方面领导力软弱的看法，

sentences.en: and a poor job communicating what had actually been delivered for American people.
sentences.zh: 以及在传达为美国人民实际交付了什么成果方面做得糟糕。

sentences.en: And also it was in the context of increasing inflation and high costs and perception that the Democratic candidate wasn't empathizing enough and feeling the pain and delivering up a solution saying,
sentences.zh: 而且这还是在通货膨胀加剧、成本高昂的背景下，人们认为民主党候选人没有足够的同理心，没有感受到痛苦，也没有提出解决方案说，

sentences.en: X, Y, and Z, I'm going to deliver for you.
sentences.zh: X、Y和Z，我会为你实现。

sentences.en: Now, meanwhile, Donald Trump said all these things that he was going to lower costs and prices and, of course, hasn't done a goddamn thing, nor is he going to.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，唐纳德·特朗普说了所有这些他要降低成本和价格的话，当然，他什么都没做，也不打算做。

sentences.en: But I don't blame, like, I don't think there was a dissipation in the effect, the after effect of Roe.
sentences.zh: 但我并不责怪，我不认为罗诉韦德案的影响、后续影响消散了。

sentences.en: I think it's there, it's strong.
sentences.zh: 我认为它还在，而且很强烈。

sentences.en: I think it did contribute to more people coming out, even in the presidential.
sentences.zh: 我认为它确实促使更多人出来投票，即使是在总统选举中。

sentences.en: And I think the results in other races have shown what's consistent with the polling, which is the vast majority of Americans, Democrat and Republican, support abortion rights.
sentences.zh: 我认为其他竞选的结果已经显示出与民调一致的情况，即绝大多数美国人，无论是民主党人还是共和党人，都支持堕胎权。

sentences.en: As to marriage equality, we'll see.
sentences.zh: 至于婚姻平权，我们走着瞧。

sentences.en: You know, it's something that I think has been, at least in Massachusetts, I mean, we've had marriage equality for 20 years now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这在某种程度上，至少在马萨诸塞州，我是说，我们已经有20年的婚姻平权了。

sentences.en: Many states have had it for some time as well.
sentences.zh: 许多州也已经实行了一段时间。

sentences.en: And the idea that a court overnight would take away that right, take away, remember, these are state marriage licenses.
sentences.zh: 而法院一夜之间就会剥夺这种权利的想法，剥夺，记住，这些是州婚姻许可证。

sentences.en: These aren't federal marriage licenses, which is why I wanted the case to begin with, the DOMA case.
sentences.zh: 这些不是联邦婚姻许可证，这就是为什么我一开始就想打那个案子，即《捍卫婚姻法案》案。

sentences.en: You know, it shouldn't happen as a matter of law.
sentences.zh: 你知道，从法律上讲，这不应该发生。

sentences.en: But imagine the destruction to families, right?
sentences.zh: 但想象一下对家庭的破坏，对吧？

sentences.en: So I hope that doesn't happen.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望那不会发生。

sentences.en: Were you surprised to see the level of importance that trans rights had in this election?
sentences.zh: 你是否惊讶于跨性别权利在这次选举中表现出的重要程度？

sentences.en: And do you think Democrats misread the electorate on the issue, as Seth Moulton, the representative from your own state, said?
sentences.zh: 你是否认为民主党人在这个问题上误读了选民，正如你所在州的众议员塞斯·莫尔顿所说的那样？

sentences.en: You know, to me, it's just so sad that we are talking about such an infinitesimal portion of the population.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对我来说，我们正在谈论人口中如此微不足道的一部分，这真是太令人悲哀了。

sentences.en: But Trump and the Republicans intentionally made that into a mountain, right?
sentences.zh: 但特朗普和共和党人故意把这变成了一座大山，对吧？

sentences.en: We're talking about such a small sliver of the population.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是人口中极小的一部分。

sentences.en: And by the way, on athletics, it's even smaller as a percentage.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，在体育运动方面，这个比例甚至更小。

sentences.en: But they did an incredibly effective job of making that an issue.
sentences.zh: 但他们非常有效地把这变成了一个议题。

sentences.en: That and immigration, I think, were two of the issues.
sentences.zh: 我认为那和移民是两个议题。

sentences.en: And DEI, what I keep on hearing you say is that they've managed to...
sentences.zh: 还有DEI，我一直听到你说的是他们设法……

sentences.en: I think, well, I think the other thing was the economy.
sentences.zh: 我想，嗯，我认为另一件事是经济。

sentences.en: At the upper hand.
sentences.zh: 占据上风。

sentences.en: I mean, at the end of the day, I think it's the economy that ended up doing Biden and Kamala Harris in.
sentences.zh: 我是说，归根结底，我认为是经济最终导致了拜登和卡玛拉·哈里斯的失败。

sentences.en: Last question.
sentences.zh: 最后一个问题。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Barring change to the Constitution, President Trump can't be re-elected.
sentences.zh: 除非修改宪法，否则特朗普总统不能连任。

sentences.en: But that's a real thing there, right?
sentences.zh: 但那确实是个真实存在的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: Darn people talking about it.
sentences.zh: 该死的人在谈论它。

sentences.en: He's got a group talking about a third term.
sentences.zh: 他有一群人在谈论第三个任期。

sentences.en: Are you worried about that?
sentences.zh: 你担心这个吗？

sentences.en: Um, I am, I am worried about that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我，我担心这个。

sentences.en: You have to think about it.
sentences.zh: 你必须考虑一下。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I have a pretty sober view of the situation, you know?
sentences.zh: 是的，我是说，我对局势有相当清醒的认识，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I mean, we live through Trump one.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们经历了特朗普的第一任期。

sentences.en: We're on to Trump two.
sentences.zh: 我们现在进入了特朗普的第二任期。

sentences.en: I was talking to a historian the other day who I called on President's Day to ask for some guidance to help me provide a context for this moment that we're in.
sentences.zh: 前几天我正在和一位历史学家交谈，我在总统日那天打电话给她，寻求一些指导，帮助我为我们所处的这个时刻提供背景。

sentences.en: And she said to me, I can't.
sentences.zh: 她对我说，我做不到。

sentences.en: We've never seen anything like this before in American history.
sentences.zh: 在美国历史上，我们从未见过这样的事情。

sentences.en: So you asked me that question, and my legit, genuine answer is, yeah, I'm worried about that.
sentences.zh: 所以你问我那个问题，我合法、真诚的回答是，是的，我担心那个。

sentences.en: I'm worried about what they're doing in terms of looking to undermine future elections.
sentences.zh: 我担心他们在破坏未来选举方面所做的事情。

sentences.en: Look at what Trump is proposing with the Postal Service and wanting to take it over, wanting to privatize it, right?
sentences.zh: 看看特朗普在邮政服务方面提出的建议，想要接管它，想要将其私有化，对吧？

sentences.en: Um, the other day in the governor's meeting, he told us all we should be working by paper ballot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，前几天在州长会议上，他告诉我们所有人都应该使用纸质选票。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's a reason they are doing that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们这样做是有原因的。

sentences.en: You know, when I speak to Democratic voters, there is an enormous amount of anger towards the Democratic Party that allowed this to happen.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我与民主党选民交谈时，他们对允许这种情况发生的民主党有巨大的愤怒。

sentences.en: They look at this and they say it was the failure of the Democratic Party that opened the door to Donald Trump coming in.
sentences.zh: 他们看着这一切，说正是民主党的失败为唐纳德·特朗普的到来打开了大门。

sentences.en: And I just wonder, as a sitting governor and a Democrat, how you respond to that.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道，作为一名在任州长和民主党人，你对此有何回应。

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: I empathize with that position.
sentences.zh: 我对那个立场感同身受。

sentences.en: Now, is it all attributable to one president and his team and his administration in the form of Joe Biden?
sentences.zh: 那么，这一切都能归咎于一位总统及其团队和他的政府，即乔·拜登吗？

sentences.en: No, I'm not suggesting that, okay?
sentences.zh: 不，我不是那个意思，好吗？

sentences.en: But there are things that happened that could have happened, that should have happened, that didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 但确实发生了一些事情，本可以发生的，本应该发生的，却没有发生。

sentences.en: And here we are.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在到了这一步。

sentences.en: So I do this job.
sentences.zh: 所以我做这份工作。

sentences.en: I became governor because I care about people.
sentences.zh: 我成为州长是因为我关心人民。

sentences.en: I want to serve people.
sentences.zh: 我想为人民服务。

sentences.en: I want to see the people in Massachusetts served.
sentences.zh: 我想看到马萨诸塞州的人民得到服务。

sentences.en: My colleagues I work with and have the privilege of working with, the Democratic governors, believe in America, believe in the needs, the wants of everyday Americans.
sentences.zh: 我共事并有幸与之共事的同事们，那些民主党州长们，相信美国，相信普通美国人的需求和愿望。

sentences.en: So it's upsetting to be here, having this conversation with you in this moment.
sentences.zh: 所以在这个时刻和你进行这样的对话，令人心烦意乱。

sentences.en: And I, too, ask, how the hell did we get here?
sentences.zh: 我也在问，我们到底是怎么走到这一步的？

sentences.en: Governor Healy, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 希利州长，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: It's great to be with you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴和你在一起。

sentences.en: That's Governor Maura Healy.
sentences.zh: 那是莫拉·希利州长。
